title: Slime Mould
description: A slime mould colony drawn in monospaced characters. Thousands of agents lay and follow trails, and their veins slowly find their way into the word grow. Press and hold to look closer at the strands; drag through it to tear them and watch them knit back.
intent: Type as something alive: the letters are not drawn, they are foraged. A faint scent of the word in the dish is all the colony gets, and the veins it builds to reach it become the letterforms.

sources.name: Slime Dish by zspotter (play.core by ertdfgcvb)
sources.what: Apache-2.0. Ported closely: the agent rules (sensor angle and distance, turn, step), the 3x3 blur with 0.9 decay, the periodic scatter phase where agents invert their sense, the two-row checkerboard character ramp and the (average + max) / 2 cube-root sampling, and press-to-magnify. Added a lure mask of the word, swipe to tear, and full-bleed layout.

sources.name: Characteristics of pattern formation and evolution in approximations of physarum transport networks by Jeff Jones (2010)
sources.what: The physarum agent model Slime Dish implements.
